---
title: Indicator Workflow Catalogue and Dashboard
subtitle: "Output 5"
date: 8 Nov 2026
---

This work package commenced according to schedule in late 2026. Initial planning activities have focused on requirements gathering and coordination between the project's technical and community engagement teams. 

Preparations for stakeholder focus groups and consultation activities are underway to ensure that catalogue requirements reflect community needs and intended use cases. 

The project has already delivered several foundational components that will support development of the catalogue, including controlled vocabularies, workflow repositories, FAIR implementation processes and ecosystem cross-referencing workflows. 

Work is progressing as planned and no significant risks to delivery have been identified at this stage. 

Once completed, the catalogue will improve discoverability of ecosystem indicator workflows and help researchers identify existing methods, data resources and gaps in ecosystem coverage.
